App release

v2.0.3 is live.

The Electron app, terminal client, and npm launcher ship together. This release gives every model provider its own usage window, remembers loaded checkpoints in the composer, calms the write-approval gates with a second confirmation, and fixes the desktop reply bug that affected every local checkpoint. The model is still v1.5; v1.6 remains a preview.

ChannelVersionWhat shipsGet it

npm launcher@d4niel-dev/dizel v2.0.3 Downloads and SHA-256 verifies the matching release npm ↗

The launcher needs Node.js 18+, Python 3.10+, and a model checkpoint. It downloads the app; it does not bundle Python or weights.

Changelog

What changed in 2.0.3.

Per-provider usage windows, a model switcher that remembers checkpoints, calmer approval gates, and the desktop reply fix.

AreaChange
Usage limitsBoth clients Every API provider gets its own context window and its own 12-hour usage counter, reset time, and compaction count. Provider defaults (128k to 1M) can be overridden in Settings; local checkpoints keep their own window. The terminal now enforces the window exactly like the desktop.
Model switcherDesktop The composer's model menu lists "Recently loaded" checkpoints for one-click reloading, with a collapsible "All checkpoints" list beneath it. History is shared with the terminal.
Tool rowsBoth clients Running tool names sweep a highlight across their letters; the terminal also shows elapsed seconds on each running row.
ApprovalsBoth clients "Always this session" and "Always allow" now ask a second time, with an amber warning that persistent trust applies to every project until revoked. Escape backs out of the warning.
FixesDesktop Replies from local checkpoints could end as "Generation ended without a reply."; the Ctrl+K palette is centered again; the Windows taskbar icon no longer starts blank; the usage meter reports the real provider window instead of a frozen 1,024.
DocsWebsite This page now tracks 2.0.3, the app screenshot was recaptured, and hover motion stays inside its element at every width.

Full history: CHANGELOG.md ↗

Availability

Known limits

What is not ready.

These are the boundaries behind the preview label. They are not release notes for a finished version.

  • ×v1.6 weights are pending.The preview checkpoint is for evaluation; v1.5 is the model you can run.
  • ×Downstream benchmarks are not published.Only held-out BPB and validation loss are available.
  • ×2,048-token context.The app does not extend the model's window.
  • ×No vision path.There is no image encoder, image tokens, or multimodal projection.

Release policy

Gates, not a date.

The stable 1.6 release ships after six measured gates pass, not on a calendar date. The repository release policy is the source of truth.
